course_review/1.summary: OSM has no golf=hole ways here; the v2+structure routing built 17 of 18 holes (hole 1 missing) and mis-routes several back-nine holes across the lake. 6 OK, 7 wrong (1 missing, 7, 8, 10, 15, 16, 18), 5 uncertain (2, 4, 9, 13, 14). Not publishable. Needs a hand-mapped osm_supplement (golf=hole ways for all 18 holes) from the OSM tee/green polygons; Overpass extract requested via webfetch_rv01_amana_browndeer.json but still queued at review time.

holes.notes: Hole missing from the page (17 holes built). OSM green way/690066085 at [41.70317,-91.56778] is hole 1's green per the routing confirm file, but no tee was found. Card Gold 329 / Blue 297, par 4. Needs a hand-mapped hole 1 (tee near the clubhouse/first-tee area ~329 yds from that green).

Tee on an OSM box, length 560 = card 559, but the routing is 'check' (75%) and the tee line plays over/next to another green ~50-80 yds in front of the tee (the G6 complex). Plausible but not confirmed.
Tee on box, fairway and green match the photo.

Routing and green right; Gold tee on a lidar pad 28 yds from the OSM box and measured 525 vs card 513 (+12): the Gold tee should probably be on the OSM box ~12 yds forward. Minor; pick unlikely to change.
Par 3, tee on box, target box on the green.
Tee on box, fairway and green match.

Gold tee walked back 61 yds onto a spot next to another green; the line runs down a cart path/rough strip beside the road and the Long iron -40 pick lands in rough. The routing (75% check) is doubtful too. Tee/green need a hand map from OSM.
Gold tee walked back 191 yds into the woods (Blue lidar pad 162 yds off); the line crosses trees. Card 414. Routing 'check' (25% posterior - the weakest hole).
Green beside the clubhouse is plausible for a 9th green, but the Gold tee is a lidar pad 67 yds from the nearest OSM box (Blue 83 yds). Card 246 par 3. Tee position unconfirmed.

Tee behind the clubhouse and the line goes straight across the big lake (landing pattern 83-100% water). A par 5 of 480 does not play over 300 yds of lake; the tee and/or green are mismatched (routing 'check', 67%).
Tee on box, straight par 4 to the green, matches the photo.
Par 3, measured 192 vs card 200 (within 10); target on the green.
Short par 4 (275) over the pond edge to the green; plausible, but the Gold tee is a lidar pad 25 yds from the OSM box. Blue PASS.
Par 3 of 120; green plausible but the tee is 94-106 yds from the nearest OSM tee box (tee_axis placement). Tee position unconfirmed.
Gold tee among back yards of the houses west of the course; the line runs through trees and gardens (landing 54% trees/OB). Tee is wrong (lidar pad 45 yds off the OSM box).
Tee in rough left of the hole; the line runs along the tree line/cart path left of the fairway; measured 445 vs card 459. Tee needs to move onto the OSM box.
Par 3 of 178, length matches; green right. Tee on a lidar pad but consistent with the card.
Tee beside houses and the line crosses the lake to a green by the clubhouse; Mid iron -38 lands 81 yds from fairway. The 18th tee/green pairing is wrong (routing 'check', 85%).
